get-back-up: When you take Severe damage, mark a Stress to reduce the severity by one threshold.
not-good-enough: When you roll damage dice, reroll any 1s or 2s.
whirlwind: When you succeed on an attack against a target within Very Close range, spend a Hope to use the attack against all other targets within Very Close range. Additional adversaries you succeed against take half damage.
a-soldiers-bond: Once per long rest, when you compliment someone or ask them about something they’re good at, you both gain 3 Hope.
reckless: Mark a Stress to gain advantage on an attack.
scramble: Once per rest, when a creature within Melee range would deal damage to you, avoid the attack and safely move out of Melee range.
versatile-fighter:
Use a different trait for an equipped weapon than the one it calls for.
When you deal damage, mark a Stress to use the maximum result of one damage die instead of rolling it.
deadly-focus: Once per rest, apply all your focus to a target of your choice: gain a +1 bonus to your Proficiency until you attack another creature, defeat the target, or the battle ends.
fortified-armor: While wearing armor, gain a +2 bonus to your damage thresholds.
champions-edge:
When you critically succeed on an attack, spend up to 3 Hope, choosing one option per Hope (each only once):
- You clear a Hit Point.
- You clear an Armor Slot.
- The target marks an additional Hit Point.
vitality:
When you choose this card, permanently gain two of the following benefits:
- One Stress slot
- One Hit Point slot
- +2 bonus to your damage thresholds
Then place this card in your vault permanently.
battle-hardened: Once per long rest, when you would make a Death Move, spend a Hope to clear a Hit Point instead.
rage-up: Before you attack, mark a Stress to gain {{strength2|a # bonus to your damage roll|a bonus to your damage roll equal to twice your Strength}}. You can Rage Up twice per attack.
blade-touched:
When 4 or more loadout cards are from the Blade domain, gain:
- +2 bonus to your attack rolls
- +4 bonus to your Severe damage threshold
glancing-blow: When you fail an attack, mark a Stress to deal weapon damage using {{halfProfUp|a Proficiency of #|half your Proficiency}}.
battle-cry: Once per long rest, while charging into danger, rally your allies: all allies who can hear you each clear a Stress and gain a Hope. They also gain advantage on attack rolls until you or an ally rolls a failure with Fear.
frenzy:
Once per long rest, go into a Frenzy until there are no adversaries within sight.
While Frenzied, you can’t use Armor Slots and gain a +10 bonus to damage rolls and a +8 bonus to your Severe damage threshold.
gore-and-glory:
When you critically succeed on a weapon attack, gain an additional Hope or clear an additional Stress.
When you deal enough damage to defeat an enemy, gain a Hope or clear a Stress.
reapers-strike: Once per long rest, spend a Hope to make an attack roll. The GM tells you which targets within range it would succeed against; choose one and force it to mark 5 Hit Points.
battle-monster: When you succeed on an attack against an adversary, mark 4 Stress to force the target to mark Hit Points equal to the Hit Points you currently have marked, instead of rolling for damage.
onslaught:
When you successfully attack with your weapon, you never deal damage below the target’s Major damage threshold (it always marks at least 2 Hit Points).
When a creature within your weapon’s range damages an ally with an attack that doesn’t include you, mark a Stress to force them to make a Reaction Roll (15); on a failure, the target marks a Hit Point.
